findings.evidence: Draft 2020-12 vocabulary, keyword, format, regex, dynamic-ref and numeric profile was not frozen.
findings.verification: Cross-implementation schema corpus produces identical results.

findings.evidence: Closed registry ID/ref/fragment/cycle/network rules were incomplete.
findings.required_change: Define canonical offline registry resolution and bounds.
findings.verification: Ref and registry attack corpus is deterministic and offline.

findings.evidence: Strict parse, Unicode, number range and canonical string subtype grammar were not frozen.
findings.verification: RFC and adversarial Unicode/number/string vectors agree across implementations.

findings.evidence: Domain-separated digest preimage framing was ambiguous.
findings.required_change: Define an exact JCS envelope and digest encoding.
findings.verification: Published preimage/digest vectors are cross-implementation stable and domain separated.

findings.evidence: Frozen dataclasses did not make nested data or aliases immutable.
findings.required_change: Require recursive immutability and strict JSON type codecs.
Freeze GEEL v1 normative semantics and error routing.
findings.verification: Full operator/type/error truth tables agree across evaluators.

findings.evidence: Static AST counts did not bound collection, ref, validation or predicate resource costs.
findings.verification: Boundary and over-limit fixtures fail with stable errors within bounded resources.

findings.evidence: Executable predicate/validator registration could reintroduce arbitrary capabilities before extension trust policy exists.
findings.required_change: Limit v1 executable registry to built-in digest-locked IDs.
findings.verification: New/overridden/mismatched executable entries are rejected before execution.

findings.evidence: Minor compatibility direction and pure migration transform identity/path were ambiguous.
findings.required_change: Define exact version pinning, explicit compatibility and deterministic transform provenance.
findings.verification: Compatibility and migration matrices are deterministic with no ambiguous path.
